machine_max.configuration.auto_handbrake: FOLLOW_VEHICLE = vehicle-defined. ALWAYS_ENABLED = always auto. ALWAYS_DISABLED = manual only. Default: FOLLOW_VEHICLE
machine_max.configuration.auto_override_: Whether to auto-pack and override machine_max:official content pack on startup/reload. Default: true
machine_max.configuration.auto_switch_ge: FOLLOW_VEHICLE = vehicle-defined. ALWAYS_ENABLED = always auto. ALWAYS_DISABLED = manual only. Default: FOLLOW_VEHICLE
machine_max.configuration.brake_off_time: Seconds to release brake to 0 after releasing the key. Lower = wheels resume rolling faster. Default: 0.1. Range: 0.05 ~ 99999.0
machine_max.configuration.drift_assist.t: Auto counter-steer during drifting. FOLLOW_VEHICLE = vehicle-defined. ALWAYS_ENABLED = always on. ALWAYS_DISABLED = off. Default: FOLLOW_VEHICLE
machine_max.configuration.full_brake_tim: Seconds to reach full brake after pressing the key. Lower = faster braking. Default: 0.3. Range: 0.05 ~ 99999.0
machine_max.configuration.full_pitch_tim: Seconds to reach full pitch after pressing the key. Lower = faster. Default: 0.25. Range: 0.05 ~ 99999.0
machine_max.configuration.full_power_tim: Seconds to reach full throttle after pressing the key. Lower = faster response. Default: 1.5 (ground), 2.5 (plane). Range: 0.05 ~ 99999.0
machine_max.configuration.full_roll_time: Seconds to reach full roll after pressing the key. Lower = faster. Default: 0.25. Range: 0.05 ~ 99999.0
machine_max.configuration.full_steering_: Seconds to reach full steering angle after pressing the key. Lower = faster steering. Default: 0.4 (ground), 0.25 (ship). Range: 0.05 ~ 99999.0
Seconds to reach full yaw after pressing the key. Lower = faster. Default: 0.25. Range: 0.05 ~ 99999.0
machine_max.configuration.ground_vehicle: Ground vehicle control smoothness and behavior settings
machine_max.configuration.ignore_assembl: Whether to ignore connector tag requirements when assembling vehicles. Default: false
machine_max.configuration.overload_enabl: Enable overload blackout/redout post-processing effect. Default: true
machine_max.configuration.overload_inten: Intensity multiplier for overload effect. Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0. Default: 1.0
machine_max.configuration.pose_preferenc: Auto rotate camera to follow vehicle heading. FOLLOW_VEHICLE = vehicle-defined. ALWAYS_ENABLED = follow. ALWAYS_DISABLED = free. Default: FOLLOW_VEHICLE
machine_max.configuration.power_off_time: Seconds to return throttle to 0 after releasing the key. Lower = faster throttle cut. Default: 2.0. Range: 0.05 ~ 99999.0
machine_max.configuration.projectile_des: Whether or not projectiles should destroy blocks when penetrating them. Default: true
machine_max.configuration.render_destroy: Dark overlay on destroyed parts. Default: true
machine_max.configuration.render_force_t: Replace cutout part rendering with translucent entity rendering. Off by default because translucent rendering often causes incorrect z-sorting and object culling. Default: false
machine_max.configuration.render_hit_whi: Show a white flash on parts when hit. Default: true
machine_max.configuration.separate_throt: Separate throttle and brake into independent channels. false = intent mode (W forward, S backward, vehicle auto-decides). true = raw pedal mode (W gas, S brake). Default: false
machine_max.configuration.should_destroy: Whether or not the parts should destroy blocks when the impact is big enough. Default: true
machine_max.configuration.show_welcome_s: Show the welcome screen when entering the title screen for the first time after launch. Default: true
machine_max.configuration.speed_turning_: Limit steering angle at high speed to prevent rollover. Default: true
machine_max.configuration.steering_off_t: Seconds to return steering to center after releasing the key. Lower = wheels straighten faster. Default: 0.2. Range: 0.05 ~ 99999.0
machine_max.configuration.subpart_destro: SubPart Destroy Advance Ticks Per Damage
Additional destroy timer advance ticks per 1 damage applied to already destroyed sub-parts. Default: 20. Range: 0 ~ 100000
Minimum destroy timer ticks for destroyed sub-parts. Default: 200. Range: 0 ~ 1000000
Destroy timer ticks per 1 max durability point for destroyed sub-parts. Default: 10. Range: 0 ~ 100000
machine_max.configuration.suppression_en: Enable suppression (desaturation/grayscale) post-processing effect. Default: true
machine_max.configuration.suppression_in: Intensity multiplier for suppression effect. Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0. Default: 1.0
